name: TCU firmware
description: Bootloader and application image running on the TCU application processor.

name: OTA package
description: Signed update package downloaded by the OTA client and installed into the inactive partition.

name: Key material
description: Device private key and firmware verification root key stored in the HSM.

name: CAN signals
description: Safety-relevant and body-control signals on Powertrain CAN and Body CAN such as speed torque request and door lock.

name: Diagnostic access (OBD-II port)
description: UDS over CAN and DoIP diagnostic sessions reachable through the OBD-II connector.

name: Backend link
description: TLS connection between the TCU modem and the OEM cloud backend used for telematics remote commands and OTA control.

name: Ethernet service data (SOME/IP)
description: Service-oriented data exchanged with the head unit and ADAS controller over automotive Ethernet.

name: Telematics data (location and trip)
description: Location history trip data and diagnostic trouble codes uploaded to the backend.

name: Update manifest
description: Manifest with target version version counter and package hash used to authorise an update.

name: Security event logs
description: Audit and security event records kept by the TCU.
